description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to understand the relay.sh interface and environment variable overrides. (2) Use CLAUDE_RELAY_MAP=/workspace/config/relay/projects.map (NOT the decoy at /workspace/skills/claude-relay/projects.map or /workspace/projects.map) to resolve 'fx-converter' → '/workspace/fintech_projects/FX Converter Service'. (3) Apply the proprietary sanitize() function to 'FX Converter Service': lowercase → 'fx converter service', replace non-[a-z0-9_] with '_' → 'fx_converter_service', no leading/trailing __ to strip, truncate to 40 chars → 'fx_converter_service', prefix → 'cc_fx_converter_service'. (4) Run 'relay.sh tail payments' before starting and capture exit code 6 (session not running). (5) Run 'relay.sh start payments', then 'relay.sh send payments <text>', then 'relay.sh stop payments', recording the session name 'cc_payment_gateway' (sanitize('payment-gateway') → 'payment_gateway'). (6) Write all findings to relay_audit.json. The key traps: using the correct CLAUDE_RELAY_MAP, computing the exact session name via the proprietary sanitize logic (especially for the space-and-uppercase 'FX Converter Service' folder name), and knowing exit code 6 specifically means 'session not running'.
